source.title: Portugal Golden Visa / ARI Requirements Reference

taxonomy_fields.label: Which qualifying Portugal Golden Visa / ARI investment route are you using?
Are you applying as an individual or with family dependents?
Is your Portugal ARI case relying only on a real-estate purchase or real-estate rehabilitation investment?
taxonomy_fields.description: AIMA's current ARI page does not list real-estate purchase or real-estate rehabilitation as qualifying categories.

taxonomy_fields.label: How many jobs will your Portugal ARI investment create?
taxonomy_fields.description: The job creation route requires creating at least 10 jobs.

taxonomy_fields.label: Can you provide employment creation proof, company records, and Social Security evidence for the job creation route?
How much will you transfer into qualifying scientific research activities in Portugal?
taxonomy_fields.description: The scientific research route requires at least EUR 500,000.

taxonomy_fields.label: Can you provide transfer proof and confirmation from the qualifying scientific research institution?
How much will you transfer into qualifying artistic production or cultural heritage recovery or maintenance?
taxonomy_fields.description: The arts / cultural heritage route requires at least EUR 250,000.

taxonomy_fields.label: Can you provide transfer proof and confirmation from the qualifying arts or cultural heritage entity?
How much will you transfer into qualifying non-real-estate investment fund units?
taxonomy_fields.description: The non-real-estate investment fund route requires at least EUR 500,000.

taxonomy_fields.label: Is the fund a non-real-estate collective investment under Portuguese law?
Does the fund have a maturity of at least 5 years?
Will at least 60% of the fund's investment be in Portuguese companies?
Can you provide fund subscription proof and fund documentation?
How much will you transfer to create or reinforce a Portuguese company?
taxonomy_fields.description: The company capitalization route requires at least EUR 500,000 plus the required job creation or maintenance commitment.

taxonomy_fields.label: Which job requirement will the company capitalization route satisfy?
Can you provide capital transfer proof, commercial registry records, and employment records for the company capitalization route?
Can you provide investment transfer proof, fund documentation, company records, or other evidence required for your selected investment route?
How many family members are included for family reunification with the ARI holder?
What is each included family member's relationship to you?
What is your nationality?
Are you a citizen of Portugal, another EU or EEA country, Andorra, or Switzerland?
taxonomy_fields.description: Portugal Golden Visa / ARI is not available to Portuguese, EU, EEA, Andorra, or Swiss nationals.

taxonomy_fields.label: Do you have a valid passport available for the Portugal ARI application?
Can you provide the required criminal record certificate issued within the last 3 months, translated into Portuguese and apostilled or consular certified where required?
Do you have a conviction for a crime punishable in Portugal by imprisonment over 1 year?
Are you under any entry or stay ban after removal?
Are you flagged in SII or UCFE for refusal of entry, stay, or return?
Which best describes your status with the Portuguese Tax Authority?
Which best describes your status with Portuguese Social Security?
Can you provide personal tax identification numbers from your country of origin, residence, or tax residence, or proof that none exists?
Can you provide a sworn statement confirming compliance with the minimum quantitative and time requirements for your investment?

post_eligibility_checklist.note: These are real Portugal Golden Visa / ARI requirements sourced from requirements_reference.md, but they describe post-approval / renewal-stage / portal-process steps rather than facts needed to determine INITIAL eligibility. They were removed from the live eligibility-screening flow and are preserved here for a future post-eligibility guidance surface. Their former requirement codes still exist in clarifications.json for that purpose.

fields.label: Do you understand the Portugal ARI minimum-stay requirement of at least 7 days in the first year and 14 days in subsequent years?
Do you understand that ARI renewal requires maintaining the qualifying investment requirements and may require updated investment proof, compliance certificates, and criminal checks?
